relation_role_structure: female-relative ↔ male-relative reciprocal role over same spouse-obstacle targets
decisive_rationale: Exact sealed R6 T09 authority already governs the reciprocal role reversal; no new T09 judgment is required.

relation_role_structure: 2 obstacle targets × 2 relative-role conditions
decisive_rationale: The sealed T09 roles establish the female/male-relative condition dimension, while nonprayer and lower-status-family are repeated obstacle targets across both role conditions: a genuine 2×2 target×condition matrix.

relation_role_structure: general voluntary-work activity → unpaid voluntary work for named organization/activity classes
decisive_rationale: Exact source parent semantics distinguish voluntary work generally from realized unpaid work for specific named organization/activity classes. q165 = none is non-substantive and excluded.

relation_role_structure: moral-duty motive/norm ↔ realized unpaid voluntary work
decisive_rationale: After the T07 general→specific refinement is accepted, actor and action domain are aligned: q170d gives duty/moral obligation as the reason/norm for voluntary work and q149b–q164b are realized unpaid-work endpoints.

authorized_or_rejected_members: within each listed wave: abany/abanyg ↔ specific abortion-condition items
relation_role_structure: general any-reason abortion permissibility → specific-condition applications
decisive_rationale: This is a direct recurrence of the sealed 1984 T03 pattern: general abortion permissibility for any reason versus concrete circumstance-specific applications.

relation_role_structure: no governed commitment↔personal-cost tie
decisive_rationale: The payment intentions are personal-cost-bearing, but the general abortion-permissibility stance does not itself establish a commitment to assist or pay; topical continuity is insufficient.

relation_role_structure: policy/permissibility stance ≠ assistance action domain
decisive_rationale: A norm about abortion permissibility and an intention to arrange/pay/provide support are different action domains; common topic does not satisfy norm→conduct actor/target/action alignment.

relation_role_structure: general environmental obligation → specific protective applications
decisive_rationale: Felt obligation to protect the environment is a general principle; using less electricity and changing diet are explicit specific applications undertaken to protect that same environment.

relation_role_structure: goal=protect environment; means=less electricity/diet/community collaboration
decisive_rationale: The accepted members explicitly name concrete means with the environmental-protection end. Q8NCVC is generic own-action efficacy toward climate change, not a specific means/mechanism, and is excluded.

relation_role_structure: environmental obligation ↔ intended protective conduct
decisive_rationale: Q7NCVE/F are respondent intentions to perform concrete environmental-protection conduct under the exact end named by Q7NCVB. Q8 items are efficacy/capacity beliefs, not conduct intentions.

relation_role_structure: personal moral-duty commitment ↔ explicit day-in-court cost-bearing intention
decisive_rationale: q817b is personal moral obligation to report corruption; q817c states willingness to report even at the explicit personal cost of a day in court.

authorized_or_rejected_members: q817b ↔ q817c; q817a excluded from actor-aligned link
relation_role_structure: personal norm ↔ intended conduct
decisive_rationale: q817b and q817c share respondent actor, corruption-reporting target/action, and conditional witness frame. q817a is a societal acceptability norm and is not actor-aligned to respondent intention.

relation_role_structure: societal acceptability + personal moral duty + cost-bearing willingness → corruption reporting
decisive_rationale: Three explicitly differentiated roles converge on the narrow proposition of reporting corruption; the configuration is bounded and does not imply a latent integrity scale.

relation_role_structure: cost-bearing items lack separate governed commitment shore
decisive_rationale: Higher prices/taxes/living-standard sacrifice are genuine costs, but neither environmental concern nor self-reported effort supplies an explicit commitment role semantically tied to those costs.

relation_role_structure: no norm shore with actor/target/action alignment
decisive_rationale: The packet contains cost willingness, concern, and self-reported effort, but no explicit norm/expected-conduct proposition.

relation_role_structure: functional adjacency, not general→subtarget hierarchy
decisive_rationale: An executive office/officeholder is institutionally related to government but is not a subtype of the government target in the required target-hierarchy sense. P2 itself preserved nested OR functional ambiguity.

relation_role_structure: POLITICAL_EXECUTIVE_OFFICE distinct from POLITICAL_GOVERNANCE_INSTITUTION
decisive_rationale: The packet supports the orthogonal institution-class distinction already recovered in T08 ancestry, but its cross-source P2 coordinate rows do not themselves create a same-wave T08 relation edge.

authorized_or_rejected_members: all Bidoon -> eligible Bidoon / Bidoon proven born in Kuwait
relation_role_structure: general population → explicitly restricted Bidoon subsets
decisive_rationale: Within the exact Bidoon-policy battery, all Bidoon is the broader population; eligibility and proven-birth formulations identify narrower subsets. This governs population scope only, not policy equivalence.

relation_role_structure: different policy actions, not same proposition under differing condition
decisive_rationale: Naturalization, deportation, residency, and status-quo options vary substantive policy action as well as population scope; they are not one proposition under a condition change.

relation_role_structure: appropriateness ratings are not an explicit forced priority/tradeoff relation
decisive_rationale: The alternatives encode different consequences, but respondents rate each option rather than choose an explicit priority tradeoff between them.

relation_role_structure: current level predicate ≠ change predicate
decisive_rationale: Both concern personal/family security, but q105 measures current security level while te105 measures change relative to last year; this is not the same proposition under a changed condition.

relation_role_structure: current security state + retrospective security change
decisive_rationale: Current level and year-over-year change are distinct temporal roles converging on the narrow personal/family security proposition.

relation_role_structure: existing moral-duty ↔ willingness canaries only
decisive_rationale: Only the sealed elderly and immigrant moral-duty/willingness links meet the T06 norm→conduct contract in this packet. Concern and other motive rows do not create additional norm→conduct links.

authorized_or_rejected_members: elderly: v278 + v281:v285; immigrants: v279 + v286:v290; response-topology variants bundled; concern-only/family/neighborhood/sick-disabled pairs excluded
relation_role_structure: willingness-to-help + explicit differentiated reasons-to-help per target
decisive_rationale: For elderly and immigrants, willingness and moral-duty/sympathy/societal-interest/self-interest/reciprocity motives all explicitly converge on helping the same named target. Mere concern+willingness pairs for other targets are too broad and are excluded.

relation_role_structure: gender/time are conditions; canonical target remains military service
decisive_rationale: The packet does not present same proposition across different governed target IDs; men/women are encoded as conditions on the same military-service target.

relation_role_structure: gender condition is not actor↔recipient reversal
decisive_rationale: Male/female military-service propositions do not reverse actor and recipient roles.

relation_role_structure: one canonical target with multiple condition axes, not target×condition crossing
decisive_rationale: Peace/war and gender form condition dimensions around military service, but T10 requires at least two repeated governed targets across conditions.

relation_role_structure: evaluation + civic-obligation roles → gendered military service
decisive_rationale: Good-experience evaluations and peace/war civic-obligation judgments are distinct roles converging on the narrow proposition of military service by gender; no latent militarism scale is authorized.

relation_role_structure: same hospitalization-support proposition under danger-to-others vs danger-to-self condition
decisive_rationale: These two items share normative predicate and psychiatric-hospitalization target and differ only in the explicit danger condition. Other packet members change intervention/action and are excluded.

relation_role_structure: no actor/target/action-aligned conduct counterpart
decisive_rationale: The packet is recommendations/coercive norms plus social-distance willingness; it contains no matching respondent conduct endpoint for those treatment norms. vigmar is a different action domain.

relation_role_structure: broad vignette topic does not supply one narrow complementary proposition
decisive_rationale: Hospitalization, examination, medication, talking to family, and marriage social distance are distinct interventions/relations; same vignette subject is insufficient for complementary-role convergence.

relation_role_structure: same expected-economic-change predicate under 1-year vs 3-year horizon
decisive_rationale: These two items share target and expected-change predicate and differ only in explicit future horizon. Other state/change pairs use different predicates and are excluded from T02.

authorized_or_rejected_members: Latin1995 p1/p2/p3; Latin2011 P3ST_A/P4ST/P5STIC1A/P5NICC2B; LiTSIII q401a/q401g; LiTSIII q812a/q813a; SouthAsiaW1 b2/b3
relation_role_structure: current state/evaluation + retrospective change + prospective change, grouped only within exact target/source
decisive_rationale: Within each listed source-target group, current, retrospective, and/or prospective roles form a bounded temporal state/change configuration. No cross-source scale or trajectory is inferred.
